name: Apartment Haselsberger
beschreibung: Apartment Haselsberger is centrally located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, a quiet place in the Kaisertal. The holiday apartment is functionally furnished and has a typical alpine style. Guests can reach the mountain lifts and hiking trails on foot in just a few minutes. The village has restaurants and a supermarket. The accommodation is suitable for self-catering guests who want to actively explore the Tirol region.
